This test checks that grid items correctly repaint when 'z-index' changes.

For this test to pass, there should be no red below.

(repaint rects
  (rect 8 236 200 100)
  (rect 8 236 200 100)
  (rect 8 236 200 100)
  (rect 8 126 200 100)
  (rect 8 126 200 100)
)
